title: [DOC2-15] Spec §2.4 requires recovery keys as update keys for every did:webvh, contradicting §2.5.8
description: Review finding DOC2-15: Spec §2.4 requires recovery keys as update keys for every did:webvh, contradicting §2.5.8 (lens DOC2). Location: spec/02-identity.md:128 (fix site); profile o365-employer-did.md:149, :194 is correct. Fix: The contradiction is real. Adjustment: the spec already distinguishes the two cases. :171 says "for a self-hosted `did:webvh` the recovering client writes the new device key into the log ... and for a CO-provisioned identity it submits the assertion to the provisioning service (§2.5.8)", and §2.5.8 says the recovery key "cannot override an organization-initiated `revokeAll`". The rationale of the :128 MUST ("so that the device key ... is written into the document by a log entry signed with the same key") applies only to the self-hosted path. Scope the :128 MUST to self-hosted (individually held) did:webvh. For CO-provisioned DIDs, recovery keys are `recoverableIdentity` only and the provisioning service writes the entry. Option (b) contradicts :171 and §2.5.8. Full text: notes/review2/DOC2-verified.md and notes/review2/DOC2.md.
